eventMetadata.context_description: Louisville's recent surge to 4-1, capped by a thrilling overtime win over NC State, anchors their 66.5% implied probability as heavy favorites against South Florida. The Cardinals boast a top-25 offense averaging over 40 points per game, led by quarterback Tyler Shough's efficient playmaking, and hold a decisive home-field edge at L&N Stadium where they've dominated foes. South Florida, sitting at 2-3 with a narrow loss to Vanderbilt exposing offensive woes (under 20 points in three of five games), faces tough matchup dynamics against Louisville's stout run defense. No major injuries alter lineups per official reports, but USF's 1-9 road record over two seasons underscores the mismatch fueling trader consensus.
